rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/users/{id} failure on Couchbase: routes/users.py update_user() calls `db.users.find_one_and_update({'id': user_id}, {'$set': update_data}, return_document=True, projection=...)`. The Couchbase adapter in /app/backend/database/couchbase_db.py defines find_one/find/update_one/delete_one but NOT find_one_and_update, so Python's attribute lookup raises AttributeError -> 500. Fix options: (a) implement find_one_and_update in CouchbaseCollection as update_one followed by find_one, or (b) refactor update_user to do update_one + find_one explicitly. Option (b) is safer because it keeps the adapter surface small and fixes this single route without changing the abstraction.
